name: bill-dispute
title: Unexplained $87 increase on a mobile bill
description: A sole trader's September mobile bill is $87.32 higher than usual with no explanation. Part of it turns out to be legitimate; part is a duplicated add-on. Getting the incorrect part credited means climbing an escalation chain inside one company, because the first two people reached cannot authorise a credit that size. Every phone number is in the +1-555-01xx range reserved for fiction, and no call is placed: this scenario drives the mock transport.

outcome.goal: Find out why the September mobile bill on account 4471-88 is USD 87.32 higher than usual, and get any incorrect charge credited back.

constraints.description: At least the USD 62.50 identified as incorrect, credited back
Credit applied on or before 12 September

organizations.name: Meridian Mobile customer service
organizations.role: General enquiries line on the bill

facts: The increase is USD 87.32 across two lines on the September bill.
USD 24.82 is roaming used on 3 and 4 September, which the account holder confirms is correct.
USD 62.50 is a second 'Unlimited Data Boost' added on 1 September while one was already active.
The duplicate add-on is visible in their system and was not requested.
blockers: Customer service can only authorise credits up to USD 50.

referrals.reason: Credits above USD 50 have to be raised by billing.

facts: Billing can see the duplicate add-on and agrees it was not requested.
Their standard goodwill credit for a duplicated add-on is USD 40.00.
A full reversal of a charge already invoiced needs account retentions.

referrals.reason: Billing say retentions can reverse the whole charge rather than issue goodwill.

offer.summary: Goodwill credit for the duplicated data add-on

facts: Retentions confirm the second add-on was applied in error on 1 September.
They can reverse the full USD 62.50 rather than issue a goodwill credit.
The roaming charge of USD 24.82 stands and is not in dispute.

offer.summary: Full reversal of the duplicated Unlimited Data Boost

facts: It will appear on the next statement rather than as a refund to the card.

offer.summary: Full reversal of the duplicated Unlimited Data Boost
